assessmentItem.title: moc-safe-delegation-item-1

choiceInteraction.prompt: During the initial assessment, the nurse notes: A newly admitted patient has changing neurologic findings. Which action is the priority?
choiceInteraction.simpleChoice: The registered nurse performs the focused assessment and determines the next intervention.
Delay action until the end of the shift.
Document the finding without reassessment or follow-up.
Delegate the clinical judgment decision to unlicensed assistive personnel.

assessmentItem.title: sic-standard-precautions-item-1

choiceInteraction.prompt: During the initial assessment, the nurse notes: A procedure may splash body fluid toward the face. Which action is the priority?

Delay action until the end of the shift.
Document the finding without reassessment or follow-up.
Delegate the clinical judgment decision to unlicensed assistive personnel.

assessmentItem.modalFeedback: PPE selection is based on the anticipated route and extent of exposure.

choiceInteraction.prompt: During the initial assessment, the nurse notes: Gloves are removed after contact with contaminated material. Which action is the priority?
choiceInteraction.simpleChoice: Perform hand hygiene immediately after glove removal.
Delay action until the end of the shift.
Document the finding without reassessment or follow-up.
Delegate the clinical judgment decision to unlicensed assistive personnel.

assessmentItem.modalFeedback: Gloves can have defects and hands can be contaminated during removal.

assessmentItem.title: sic-standard-precautions-item-3

choiceInteraction.prompt: During the initial assessment, the nurse notes: A nurse sustains a needlestick injury. Which action is the priority?
choiceInteraction.simpleChoice: Wash the area, report promptly, and begin the exposure protocol.
Delay action until the end of the shift.
Document the finding without reassessment or follow-up.
Delegate the clinical judgment decision to unlicensed assistive personnel.

assessmentItem.modalFeedback: Immediate cleansing and timely evaluation reduce preventable harm and enable indicated prophylaxis.

assessmentItem.title: sic-standard-precautions-item-4

choiceInteraction.prompt: During the initial assessment, the nurse notes: Clean supplies are placed near used wound-care materials. Which action is the priority?
choiceInteraction.simpleChoice: Separate clean and contaminated fields before continuing care.
Delay action until the end of the shift.
Document the finding without reassessment or follow-up.
Delegate the clinical judgment decision to unlicensed assistive personnel.

assessmentItem.modalFeedback: Maintaining separation limits indirect transmission.

assessmentItem.title: sic-standard-precautions-item-5

choiceInteraction.prompt: During the initial assessment, the nurse notes: A nurse plans to recap a used needle by hand. Which action is the priority?

Delay action until the end of the shift.
Document the finding without reassessment or follow-up.
Delegate the clinical judgment decision to unlicensed assistive personnel.

assessmentItem.modalFeedback: Avoiding manipulation of used sharps reduces percutaneous injury risk.

assessmentItem.title: psi-therapeutic-communication-item-1

choiceInteraction.prompt: During the initial assessment, the nurse notes: A patient says, “Nothing will ever get better.” Which action is the priority?
choiceInteraction.simpleChoice: Acknowledge the distress and ask directly about thoughts of self-harm.
Delay action until the end of the shift.
Document the finding without reassessment or follow-up.
Delegate the clinical judgment decision to unlicensed assistive personnel.

assessmentItem.modalFeedback: Hopeless statements warrant therapeutic exploration and direct safety assessment.

assessmentItem.title: psi-therapeutic-communication-item-2

choiceInteraction.prompt: During the initial assessment, the nurse notes: A grieving patient becomes silent and tearful. Which action is the priority?
choiceInteraction.simpleChoice: Remain present and allow silence while offering the patient time to speak.
Delay action until the end of the shift.
Document the finding without reassessment or follow-up.
Delegate the clinical judgment decision to unlicensed assistive personnel.

assessmentItem.modalFeedback: Therapeutic silence communicates presence without forcing conversation.

assessmentItem.title: psi-therapeutic-communication-item-3

choiceInteraction.prompt: During the initial assessment, the nurse notes: A patient says, “Everyone is judging me.” Which action is the priority?

Delay action until the end of the shift.
Document the finding without reassessment or follow-up.
Delegate the clinical judgment decision to unlicensed assistive personnel.

assessmentItem.modalFeedback: Reflection validates the expressed feeling and invites clarification.

assessmentItem.title: psi-therapeutic-communication-item-4

choiceInteraction.prompt: During the initial assessment, the nurse notes: A patient is anxious about a procedure. Which action is the priority?

Delay action until the end of the shift.
Document the finding without reassessment or follow-up.
Delegate the clinical judgment decision to unlicensed assistive personnel.

assessmentItem.modalFeedback: Open exploration identifies the patient's need before teaching.

choiceInteraction.prompt: During a change-of-condition reassessment, the nurse notes: The patient has a possible infection but a normal temperature. Which action is the priority?
choiceInteraction.simpleChoice: Continue evaluating for sepsis using the complete clinical picture and organ-function findings.
Delay action until the end of the shift.
Document the finding without reassessment or follow-up.
Delegate the clinical judgment decision to unlicensed assistive personnel.

assessmentItem.modalFeedback: A normal temperature does not exclude serious infection or sepsis.

assessmentItem.title: pa-sepsis-recognition-item-14

choiceInteraction.prompt: During a change-of-condition reassessment, the nurse notes: Ordered cultures and treatment are pending while the patient deteriorates. Which action is the priority?
choiceInteraction.simpleChoice: Coordinate time-sensitive diagnostics and treatment while continuing stabilization and escalation.
Delay action until the end of the shift.
Document the finding without reassessment or follow-up.
Delegate the clinical judgment decision to unlicensed assistive personnel.

assessmentItem.modalFeedback: Deterioration requires parallel action rather than waiting passively for one step to finish.

assessmentItem.title: pa-sepsis-recognition-item-15

choiceInteraction.prompt: During a change-of-condition reassessment, the nurse notes: Blood pressure remains low after initial interventions. Which action is the priority?
choiceInteraction.simpleChoice: Escalate immediately and continue reassessing perfusion and treatment response.
Delay action until the end of the shift.
Document the finding without reassessment or follow-up.
Delegate the clinical judgment decision to unlicensed assistive personnel.

assessmentItem.modalFeedback: Persistent hypotension indicates ongoing instability and need for higher-level support.
